Fenty Beauty’s iconic **[Pro Filt’r Soft Matte Longwear Foundation](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462378635079142,imageDocid:5719359905840537266,gpcid:16190591014885023720,headlineOfferDocid:705077293269476968,catalogid:10972148907499153352,productDocid:6508002703916856232,rds:PC_16190591014885023720%7CPROD_PC_16190591014885023720&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjuvsrv64OYAxVeXEEAHVaHHxkQxa4PeggIAggBCAsQAQ)** remains a gold standard in the beauty industry—celebrated for its `revolutionary shade range, long-wearing formula, and real-skin finish`.

#### **Key Overview & Specifications** 

- **Coverage:** Buildable **medium-to-full coverage** 
- **Finish:** Soft matte (smooth, shine-free, and skin-like—never flat or chalky)
- **Shade Range:** **50 inclusive shades** catering to every skin tone and undertone
- **Size & Price:** Standard 1.08 oz / 32 mL bottle (around $40), plus mini sizes available in select shades
- **Key Technology:** Climate-adaptive formula designed to resist sweat, shine, and humidity without clogging pores[[1]](https://fentybeauty.com/products/pro-filtr-soft-matte-longwear-foundation-335)

#### **Performance Breakdown** 

- **The Texture:** It starts off with a fluid, lightweight liquid feel that glides on smoothly. It dries down relatively quickly, so working in sections across the face is recommended.[[1]](https://www.buzzfeed.com/beccamonaghan/fenty-beauty-pro-filtr-fluid-flex-foundation-review)
- **The Wear:** Renowned for its **all-day staying power** , it locks into place and controls oil remarkably well, making it a favorite for combination-to-oily skin types. Reviewers note that it holds up impressively against heat and active days.[[1]](https://fentybeauty.com/products/pro-filtr-soft-matte-longwear-foundation-335)[[2]](https://www.buzzfeed.com/beccamonaghan/fenty-beauty-pro-filtr-fluid-flex-foundation-review)
- **The Finish:** Despite being a matte foundation, it doesn't look mask-like. It blurs pores, evens out redness, and leaves a diffused, soft-focus ("filtered") look.[[1]](https://fentybeauty.com/products/pro-filtr-soft-matte-longwear-foundation-335)
- **Shade Matching:** With 50 shades, finding a match is easier than most brands, though finding the exact right undertone can take a bit of swatching (as oxidation can slightly shift some shades after drying down). *Tip: Check reviews or use digital finders on platforms like the [Fenty Beauty Official Store](https://fentybeauty.com/products/pro-filtr-soft-matte-longwear-foundation-335).* [[1]](https://fentybeauty.com/products/pro-filtr-soft-matte-longwear-foundation-335)

#### **Pros & Cons** 

##### **Pros** 

- **Massive shade inclusivity** with clearly labeled cool, warm, and neutral undertones.
- **Oil control and sweat-resistance** that lasts through long hours.
- **Buildability** —you can sheer it out for a natural look or build it up to full coverage.
- **Non-comedogenic** formula that feels breathable despite the strong wear.[[1]](https://fentybeauty.com/products/pro-filtr-soft-matte-longwear-foundation-335)[[2]](https://www.buzzfeed.com/beccamonaghan/fenty-beauty-pro-filtr-fluid-flex-foundation-review)

##### **Cons** 

- **Dries fast** , meaning you need to blend quickly and prep dry skin thoroughly (it can cling to dry patches if skin isn't well-hydrated beforehand).
- **Oxidation risk** , as some users notice a minor shift in depth a few minutes after application.

If you're looking to dive deeper, I can help you with:

- **Shade recommendations** based on what you currently wear in other brands (like MAC, NARS, or Maybelline).
- **Skin-prep and priming tips** to make sure a matte formula doesn't cling to dry zones.
- **Comparing Pro Filt'r** against Fenty’s hydrating or newer fluid-flex formulas.

Let me know which of these you'd like to explore!
